methodologyNotes: Specs sourced primarily from official manufacturer pages (elgato.com, fortinge.com, autocue.com, glidegear.net, desview.com, prompterpeople.com, teleprompterpad.com — several fetched via a reader-proxy after the manufacturer's own site returned 403/429 bot-protection responses to direct requests) and corroborated via authorized resellers publishing the same manufacturer spec sheets (markertek.com, B&H Photo Video, thinfilter.com, raiveon.com, review-rating.com) plus one independent review (digitalcameraworld.com). Two seeds could not be verified as real, currently-sold SKUs after exhaustive search and were swapped for verified, notable, currently-sold alternatives so that no entry is fabricated: 'Fotga 10-inch teleprompter' (no manufacturer page, no B&H/Amazon/eBay listing found under that name) -> replaced with Fortinge VEGA 19in broadcast studio prompter; 'Glide Gear TMP2200' (Glide Gear's actual current lineup is TMP50/TMP75/TMP100/TMP500/TMP750/TMP1000 per glidegear.net's own collection page — no TMP2200 exists) -> replaced with Glide Gear TMP1000, the brand's flagship studio rail teleprompter. Separately, 'Padcaster Parrot 2' and 'Parrot Teleprompter 2' in the seed list are the same product under two phrasings; Padcaster has since redesigned and renamed it the 'Parrot Pro Teleprompter Kit' (raiveon.com confirms: 'formerly known as the Parrot V2'), so it is listed once under its current name. 'Neewer X1' ships today as the 'Neewer X1 Pro II' (same line, current revision) and is listed under that name. glass_reflection_ratio is the manufacturer-stated beamsplitter transmission/reflection split (e.g. '70/30'); left null where the source gives only a qualitative description (Desview T2's 'single-sided high reflective mirror') or a differently formatted metric (Neewer X1 Pro II publishes '75% light transmission', not an X/Y ratio). max_tablet_size_in is the largest tablet dimension the mount/tray is rated for; null for self-contained units with their own built-in screen (Elgato Prompter, Elgato Prompter XL), for monitor-based broadcast rigs with no tablet tray (Ikan PT4900, Fortinge VEGA, Autocue 17in Pioneer), and for phone-only mounts with no tablet mode (Padcaster Parrot Pro); Datavideo TP-300's figure is the tray's max tablet WIDTH (7.8in / 198mm), not a diagonal, since that is the only dimension Datavideo publishes. weight_lb is converted from kg/g on pages that publish metric only. Prices are the observed US retail figure at a named authorized reseller in the absence of a published manufacturer MSRP — common for broadcast-tier gear, which is typically quoted per configuration/POA — and are left null where no reliable USD figure could be confirmed from any source (Desview T2, Datavideo TP-300). All sources accessed 2026-08-01.
